en.name: Mathematician
en.ability: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
en.flavor: Any consistent formal system x, within which a certain amount of elementary arithmetic can be carried out is incomplete; that is, there are statements of the language of x which can neither be proved nor disproved in x. Ergo, you are drunk.
